method: Opened the exact public share page in Chrome, HTTP 200, no sign-in needed; inspected its rendered image elements, downloaded the 10 unique public PNG responses into the ignored local verification directory, and visually viewed every full image.
observedPageTitle: ChatGPT - 冰蓝卷发猫标潮酷少年手办
duplicateExplanation: The main displayed image repeats the first image from the set.
identity: All references depict the same ice-blue-haired, dark-hoodie character with a cat chest mark, cargo trousers, earrings, and chunky shoes. Facial expression and small shapes vary between these generated stills.
direction: The greeting arm is viewer-left. Existing baseline rig greets with viewer-right; do not silently mirror the whole character or its chest mark/earrings.
quality: 1024×1536 PNG images with clean full-character detail, including hair tips and both shoes. They contain an opaque pale-gray studio backdrop and floor shadows. They are not transparent layers, a 3D model, motion capture, or a pre-registered animation sequence.
usableConstraints: Keep upper arm near the body and shoulder low.
Flex the elbow to bring an open palm toward lower-face/cheek height.
Use small alternating wrist/forearm changes at the raised pose.
Keep both feet planted and preserve face/hair identity.
Keep palm clear of facial features; check hair/hand occlusion.
limitations: The supplied order is the public page image order, not a verified timeline.
Hidden elbow/wrist axes cannot be recovered exactly from loose sleeves in one frontal view.
The set does not supply an explicit lowering or return-to-idle sequence; timing and interpolation must be authored.
Small differences in face, clothing folds, scale, stance and silhouette make direct still-image swaps unsuitable for a continuous greeting.
No image was converted into a public runtime asset by this inspection task.

images.jointsAndPath: Both shoulders relaxed; arms down, wrists below waist, fingers softly curled. The viewer-left arm is the future greeting arm.
images.occlusion: No arm crosses the torso. This is the only clearly neutral down-arm reference.

images.jointsAndPath: Viewer-left upper arm moves outward slightly; forearm comes forward toward the viewer and hand stays below shoulder level. Palm is angled downward/inward.
images.occlusion: Loose sleeve hides the elbow location and foreshortens the forearm; joint angles cannot be measured reliably from this view.

images.jointsAndPath: Viewer-left hand rises near upper-chest height; elbow remains low and bent. Fingers separate and palm begins facing the viewer.
images.occlusion: Sleeve cuff hides the wrist base. The hand overlaps only its own cuff, leaving the face unobstructed.

images.jointsAndPath: Viewer-left palm faces the viewer at chest/shoulder level; elbow flex is stronger and the upper arm remains mostly beside the torso.
images.occlusion: Wide sleeve overlaps the torso edge. This is a useful elbow-fold and sleeve-volume reference, not a timing sample.

images.jointsAndPath: Hand reaches lower-face height, palm toward viewer, fingers open. Upper arm remains modestly abducted; most height comes from a bent elbow.
images.occlusion: Palm is clear of the cheek/hair silhouette, with a small gap. Full body and both shoes remain visible.

images.jointsAndPath: Viewer-left palm is close to cheek height; forearm is nearly upright. Shoulder stays down, elbow near the side rather than a straight outstretched arm.
images.occlusion: Fingers approach the ear/hair boundary. The far side of elbow and wrist is not visible.

images.jointsAndPath: Raised palm shifts outward from the face; wrist/palm angle changes slightly while bent elbow and low shoulder remain.
images.occlusion: Head and body lean subtly. The silhouette is not pixel-aligned with reference 06.

images.jointsAndPath: Palm returns closer to cheek, forearm nearly upright; hand remains open and front-facing.
images.occlusion: Fingertips approach the ear and hair. Strong overlap should be avoided when adapting a layered 2D rig.

images.jointsAndPath: Palm is a little farther left and lower than reference 08; arm remains bent and fingers spread.
images.occlusion: Head, feet and clothing folds vary slightly across the generated stills, so direct frame swaps would visibly jump.

images.jointsAndPath: Palm stays beside the lower face, slightly angled; bent elbow and relatively relaxed shoulder continue.
images.occlusion: Still ends with the arm raised. No supplied picture establishes the lowering/settling pose or continuous timing.
